Maya C.: Heads-up — after yesterday's canary I'm seeing a ~12% increase in token latency on several low-latency routes. Link to quick snapshot: https://perf.redwood/snap/1854003210 :eyes:
Trent H.: Do you have p50/p95/p99 diffs?
Maya C.: p50 +5%, p95 +9%, p99 +12%. The flamegraph points at kernel selector choosing matmul_fallback more often for small batches (seq < 64).
Sophia R.: Any change to KV cache hit rates? sometimes batching shifts increase misses.
Maya C.: Yes — KV miss rate +18% on the affected routes for prompt-reuse flows. Looks correlated with batching window widening (we bumped to 12ms last week).
Ajay K.: Remind me — we changed the quantization check in kernel selector in v3.2.4, right? That might cause fallbacks.
Liza M.: I merged the selector tweak — default len_threshold=64 and prefer_quantized=true.
Maya C.: Sample relevant config/logs:
```
kernel_selector:
  len_threshold: 64
  prefer_quantized: true
```
And log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T22:14:03.123Z kernel_selector model=redwood/gpt-xx seq=48 batch=1 selected=matmul_fallback reason=quant_check_fail
2026-03-17T22:14:03.124Z kv_cache model=redwood/gpt-xx prompt_id=abc123 hit=false
```
perf-bot: New perf snapshot uploaded: https://perf.redwood/token_latency_breakdown/1854003210 (auto-alert: p99 up 11% on route /v1/generate)
Trent H.: OK. Two things: 1) we need per-route kernel_variant histogram and per-token kv_hit label in telemetry, 2) the billing/token-accounting pipeline needs to attribute CPU/GPU cost to the actual kernel used (current unit economics assume idealized kernel).
Ajay K.: I can add token-level tags: `kernel_variant` and `kv_cache_status`. That will let us slice cost by exact execution path. Example event payload: `token_event{kernel_variant=\"matmul_fallback\",kv_cache=\"miss\"}`
Sophia R.: Also add `batch_size` and `seq_len` dimensions so we can correlate why small batches flip kernel choice.
Liza M.: Short mitigation: revert len_threshold to 32 and roll a canary to reduce fallbacks while we instrument.
Maya C.: I'll schedule a canary roll tomorrow 03:00 UTC and watch p99 + token-cost delta. Command I'll run:
```
runtimesctl rollout --config kernel_selector.len_threshold=32 --targets canary --monitor token_latency,p99,kvcache_hit_rate
```
Trent H.: For dashboards: add a per-route tile showing kernel mix (stacked by kernel_variant) and a per-token cost card that multiplies token counts by kernel-unit-cost. I'll own the dashboard changes.
Liza M.: I'll also add a runtime flag to safely force quantized kernels for a single experiment (no redeploy).
Maya C.: Action items:
- Maya C.: run canary + post snapshot (owner)
- Ajay K.: add token-level labels (kernel_variant, kv_cache_status, batch_size, seq_len) to telemetry (owner)
- Trent H.: update dashboards to show kernel mix and per-token cost (owner)
- Liza M.: prepare runtime flag & rollback playbook (owner)
Everyone: please react with :thumbsup: if this plan is good.
Trent H.: :thumbsup: will also add an alert for kernel_fallback_rate > 5% on high-QPS routes.
Maya C.: Thanks — I'll post canary results and perf snapshots in this thread.
perf-bot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-1854003210 (monitoring token_latency, kvcache_hit_rate)
Maya C.: ping @Trent H. @Ajay K. @Liza M. — will update after first 30m of canary. :eyes:
